mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boardReply(reply_num, r_content, r_reg_date, r_block, bnum, memberIdx) VALUES (reply_seq.NEXTVAL, #{r_content}, SYSDATE, 0, #{bnum}, #{memberIdx} )
mapper.select: SELECT reply_num, userName, r_content, r_block, bnum, b.memberIdx, TO_CHAR(r_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') r_reg_date FROM boardReply b JOIN member1 m ON b.memberIdx = m.memberIdx WHERE b.bnum = #{bnum} AND b.r_block = 0 ORDER BY reply_num DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY
